entries.title: Read conversation replies as messages
entries.body: Opening a reply above the message box now shows your question in a grey bubble, followed by your first mate's answer. Press a long question to open or fold it. The same layout appears in the existing reply sheet on iPhone and iPad; reading or closing it sends nothing.

picture.alt: A conversation note with the question in a grey bubble below You and an unboxed multiline answer below the first mate's mark and label
